column1: # What a new account is given at its first sign-in (docs/notes/no-tutorial.md), one config:
# gameplay/srp/new_account.options. srp reads it from its game data at start: a key missing, or an
# item, slot, modification or faction the data lacks, stops it, naming it. Only new accounts get it.
# An item is its `items_dict` name; a slot a kit's (0..6 the armour, 3 the back, 7 weapon 1 and 8
# its first ammo, 10 weapon 2 and 11 its first ammo, 13.. the pockets).
#   level                     the level it starts at, one point short of the next (its first
#   skills/<id>               the points of a skill (skills_tree.options' id), within the level
#   rounds                    the rounds it owns of every ammo
#   faction                   the faction it takes quests from (1: the Scavengers), at
#   reputation_level          this level of reputation with it (5: their highest)
#   own/<item>                what it owns besides the kits: units of a stack, else that many items
#                             (a kit's pockets take theirs from these stacks)

# preset_

/... preset p's three kits (1 to 5, from 1 on; 1 is the kits, active):
#     all_kits/<slot>         the item each of its three kits wears there: one item, worn by all
#                             (none: nothing every kit wears; a kit of no rows is empty)
#     kit_<n>/<slot>          what its kit n wears more: its weapons, and their ammo (the kit's
#                             ammo bags shared: one for each ammo slot after the first, the
#                             first the rest; a slot filled to the most its bags take)
#     pocket_units            the units of a pocket: each pocket's item has what a pocket of
#                             so many holds of it (a booster fills one alone: one)
#                             the modifications of its own (modifications.options) an item it is
#                             given has, worn or owned, after those it comes with (items.tsv
#                             `start`): every such item has them all, at most 3 in all
